111: He created the beings of the 8.4 million species.
ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ; ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
One on whom He casts His glance of grace, He leads to meet the Guru.
ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਕਾਟਿ. ਸਦਾ ਜਨ ਨਿਰਮਲ; ਦਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਸੁਹਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
Their sins cut away, His servants are forever pure, made beautiful by the Name at the True Door. ॥6॥
When He calls for the account, who can give it?
No peace comes from reckoning up twos and threes.
ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਿ ਲਏ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਾਚਾ; ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
The True Lord God Himself forgives, and having forgiven, unites with Himself. ॥7॥
He Himself acts, and He Himself causes others to act.
Through the perfect Guru's Word He unites with Himself.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ; ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੨॥੩॥
O Nanak, through the Name honour is obtained; He Himself unites in union. ॥8॥2॥3॥
The One Himself moves about, hidden from view.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵੇਖਾ; ਤਾ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਭਿੰਨਾ ॥
When I see Him through the Guru, this mind is drenched with His love.
ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਤਜਿ. ਸਹਜ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਏਕੋ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
Giving up craving, they found the peace of poise, and enshrined the One in their minds. ॥1॥
ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ; ਇਕਸੁ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who fix their consciousness on the One.
ਗੁਰਮਤੀ. ਮਨੁ ਇਕਤੁ ਘਰਿ ਆਇਆ; ਸਚੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰੰਗਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Through the Guru's teaching the mind comes to its one home, dyed in the colour of the True One. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਭੂਲਾ; ਤੈਂ ਆਪਿ ਭੁਲਾਇਆ ॥
This world is deluded; You Yourself have deluded it.
Forgetting the One, it is entranced by duality.
ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਫਿਰੈ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਭੂਲਾ; ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ. ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
Night and day it wanders, lost in doubt; without the Name it suffers pain. ॥2॥
Those who are dyed in the love of the Architect of destiny,
ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ; ਜੁਗ ਚਾਰੇ ਜਾਤੇ ॥
through service to the Guru, are known throughout the four ages.
ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਪਿ ਦੇਇ ਵਡਿਆਈ; ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
One whom He Himself blesses with honour merges in the Lord's Name. ॥3॥
Engrossed in attachment to Maya, one does not remember the Lord;
bound in the city of Death, he suffers pain.
ਅੰਨਾ ਬੋਲਾ. ਕਿਛੁ ਨਦਰਿ. ਨ ਆਵੈ; ਮਨਮੁਖ ਪਾਪਿ ਪਚਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
Blind and deaf, he sees nothing; the self-willed are consumed by sin. ॥4॥
ਇਕਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ; ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਏ ॥
Some are dyed in Your love, whom You Yourself have attuned to You.
Through loving devotion they are pleasing to Your mind.
ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਨਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ; ਸਭ ਇਛਾ ਆਪਿ ਪੁਜਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
They serve the True Guru, ever the Giver of peace; You Yourself fulfil all their desires. ॥5॥
O dear Lord, I seek Your sanctuary forever.
You Yourself forgive, and bless with honour.
ਜਮਕਾਲੁ. ਤਿਸੁ ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ; ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
The Messenger of Death does not come near one who meditates on the Lord's Name. ॥6॥
Those who are pleasing to the Lord are dyed in His love night and day.
My God has united them in union with Himself.
ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਸਚੇ. ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ; ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ. ਸਚੁ ਬੁਝਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
Forever and ever, O True Lord, they remain in Your sanctuary; You Yourself give them understanding of Truth. ॥7॥
ਜਿਨ ਸਚੁ ਜਾਤਾ; ਸੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਣੇ ॥
Those who know the True One merge in the True One.
They sing the Lord's praises and speak the Truth.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ; ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਤਾੜੀ ਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੩॥੪॥
O Nanak, those imbued with the Name remain detached, absorbed in deep meditation within their own home. ॥8॥3॥4॥
One who dies through the Word is truly known as dead (to ego).
ਕਾਲੁ ਨ ਚਾਪੈ; ਦੁਖੁ ਨ ਸੰਤਾਪੈ ॥
Death does not crush him, nor does pain afflict him.
ਜੋਤੀ ਵਿਚਿ ਮਿਲਿ. ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ; ਸੁਣਿ ਮਨ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
His light blends and merges into the Light; hearing the Word, O mind, he merges in the True One. ॥1॥
ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ; ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਾਇ. ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who are honoured through the Lord's Name.
ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ. ਸਚਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ; ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Serving the True Guru, they fix their consciousness on the True One; through the Guru's teaching they merge in poise. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
The body is frail, a flimsy garment the soul wears out.
Attached to duality, the soul does not find His mansion.
112: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਜਲਦੀ ਫਿਰੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ; ਬਿਨੁ ਪਿਰ. ਬਹੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
Night and day it wanders burning, day and night; without the Husband it suffers great pain. ॥2॥
Neither body nor caste goes on to the world hereafter.
ਜਿਥੈ ਲੇਖਾ ਮੰਗੀਐ; ਤਿਥੈ ਛੁਟੈ. ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਏ ॥
Where the account is called for, there one is released only by practising Truth.
ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਨਿ ਸੇ ਧਨਵੰਤੇ; ਐਥੈ ਓਥੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
Those who serve the True Guru are wealthy; here and hereafter they merge in the Name. ॥3॥
One who makes fear and love of Him her adornment,
by the Guru's grace finds His mansion, her true home.
ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਰਵੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ; ਮਜੀਠੈ ਰੰਗੁ ਬਣਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
Night and day, day and night, she enjoys Him, and is dyed in His love as fast as madder. ॥4॥
The Husband dwells forever with all,
but rare is the one who, by the Guru's grace, beholds Him with his eyes.
ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਤਿ ਊਚੋ ਊਚਾ; ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
My God is the highest of the high; in His mercy He Himself unites us with Him. ॥5॥
This world is asleep in attachment to Maya.
Forgetting the Name, it is ruined in the end.
ਜਿਸ ਤੇ ਸੁਤਾ. ਸੋ ਜਾਗਾਏ; ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
The One by whose will it sleeps wakes it up; through the Guru's teaching understanding comes. ॥6॥
One who drinks the nectar dispels doubt.
By the Guru's grace he attains liberation and the highest state.
ਭਗਤੀ ਰਤਾ ਸਦਾ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ; ਆਪੁ ਮਾਰਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
Imbued with devotion, he remains forever detached; killing self-conceit, he is united with Him. ॥7॥
He Himself creates, and puts all to their tasks.
He Himself delivers sustenance to the 8.4 million species.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਸਚਿ ਰਾਤੇ; ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ. ਸੁ ਕਾਰ ਕਰਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੪॥੫॥
O Nanak, those who meditate on the Name are dyed in the True One; they do the work that pleases Him. ॥8॥4॥5॥
Within each one He has placed the diamond and the ruby (His light).
Through the Guru's Word, it is assayed and appraised.
ਜਿਨ ਸਚੁ ਪਲੈ. ਸਚੁ ਵਖਾਣਹਿ; ਸਚੁ ਕਸਵਟੀ ਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
Those who have Truth in their laps speak Truth, and apply the touchstone of Truth. ॥1॥
ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ; ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ. ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who enshrine the Guru's Bani in their minds.
ਅੰਜਨ ਮਾਹਿ. ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Amid Maya they have found the Pure Lord, and their light merges into the Light. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Within this body is a great expanse (of Maya).
The Name of the Pure Lord is utterly inaccessible and infinite.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ. ਸੋਈ ਪਾਏ; ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
He alone obtains it who becomes Guru-facing; the Lord Himself forgives and unites him. ॥2॥
One in whom my Master implants Truth,
by the Guru's grace, fixes his consciousness on the True One.
ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਵਰਤੈ ਸਭਨੀ ਥਾਈ; ਸਚੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
The Truest of the true pervades all places; he merges into the True One. ॥3॥
My Beloved is carefree and true.
He cuts away sins and faults.
ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਈਐ; ਭੈ ਭਾਇ ਭਗਤਿ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
Meditate on Him forever with love and affection; in fear and love of Him, devotion is made firm. ॥4॥
ਤੇਰੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਸਚੀ; ਜੇ ਸਚੇ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
Devotion to You is true, if it pleases You, O True One.
He Himself gives and does not regret it.
ਸਭਨਾ ਜੀਆ ਕਾ ਏਕੋ ਦਾਤਾ; ਸਬਦੇ ਮਾਰਿ ਜੀਵਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
He alone is the Giver of all beings; through the Word He kills (the ego) and brings to life. ॥5॥
ਹਰਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਬਾਝਹੁ; ਮੈ ਕੋਈ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
O Lord, without You I have no one.
ਹਰਿ ਤੁਧੈ ਸੇਵੀ, ਤੈ ਤੁਧੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ॥
O Lord, I serve You and I praise You.
ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਲੈਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਾਚੇ; ਪੂਰੈ ਕਰਮਿ ਤੂੰ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
Unite me with Yourself, O True God; You are found by perfect grace. ॥6॥
ਮੈ. ਹੋਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ; ਤੁਧੈ ਜੇਹਾ ॥
For me there is no other like You.
By Your glance of grace my body is made fruitful.
ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਾਰਿ ਸਮਾਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖਹਿ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
Night and day You care for and protect us, O Lord; the Guru-facing merge in poise. ॥7॥
ਤੁਧੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ; ਮੈ ਹੋਰੁ. ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
For me there is none as great as You.
You Yourself created, and You Yourself destroy.
113: ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਘੜਿ ਭੰਨਿ ਸਵਾਰਹਿ; ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਸੁਹਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੫॥੬॥
You Yourself make, break and adorn; O Nanak, through the Name we are made beautiful. ॥8॥5॥6॥
He Himself is the enjoyer in all hearts.
The unseen, inaccessible, infinite Lord pervades all.
ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ. ਮੇਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ; ਸਹਜੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
Meditate on my Lord God through the Guru's Word, and you shall merge intuitively into the True One. ॥1॥
ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ; ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ; ਗੁਰਸਬਦੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who enshrine the Guru's Word in their minds.
ਸਬਦੁ ਸੂਝੈ. ਤਾ ਮਨ ਸਿਉ ਲੂਝੈ; ਮਨਸਾ ਮਾਰਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
When one understands the Word, one wrestles with the mind; subduing desire, one merges in the Lord. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
The five demons (passions) are plundering the world.
The blind self-willed have no sense or awareness of it.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ. ਸੁ ਅਪਣਾ ਘਰੁ ਰਾਖੈ; ਪੰਚ ਦੂਤ. ਸਬਦਿ ਪਚਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
One who becomes Guru-facing protects his own home; through the Word the five demons are destroyed. ॥2॥
ਇਕਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ; ਸਦਾ ਸਚੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ॥
Some, through the Guru, are forever dyed in the love of the True One.
Intuitively they serve God, intoxicated night and day.
ਮਿਲਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਸਚੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ; ਹਰਿ ਦਰਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
Meeting the Beloved, they sing the praises of the True One, and are honoured at the Lord's door. ॥3॥
Then came duality (the formless and the form), and the three-qualitied Maya.
ਚਉਥੀ ਪਉੜੀ. ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਊਚੀ; ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
The fourth state, beyond these, is lofty, reached through the Guru; there one practises Truth alone. ॥4॥
ਸਭੁ ਹੈ ਸਚਾ; ਜੇ ਸਚੇ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
All is true, if it pleases the True One.
ਜਿਨਿ ਸਚੁ ਜਾਤਾ; ਸੋ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥
One who knows the True One merges in poise.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਰਣੀ ਸਚੇ ਸੇਵਹਿ; ਸਾਚੇ ਜਾਇ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
The way of life of the Guru-facing is to serve the True One; they go and merge into the True One. ॥5॥
ਸਚੇ ਬਾਝਹੁ; ਕੋ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੂਆ ॥
Without the True One there is no other at all.
ਦੂਜੈ ਲਾਗਿ ਜਗੁ; ਖਪਿ ਖਪਿ ਮੂਆ ॥
Attached to duality, the world is consumed and dies.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ. ਸੁ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਣੈ; ਏਕੋ ਸੇਵਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
One who becomes Guru-facing knows only the One; serving the One, he finds peace. ॥6॥
All beings and creatures are in Your sanctuary.
ਆਪੇ ਧਰਿ ਦੇਖਹਿ; ਕਚੀ ਪਕੀ ਸਾਰੀ ॥
You Yourself place the pieces on the board and watch them, the unripe and the ripe.
ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਆਪੇ ਕਾਰ ਕਰਾਏ; ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
Night and day He Himself has His work done, and He Himself unites in union. ॥7॥
You Yourself unite, and see all close at hand.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਵਰਤੈ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੬॥੭॥
O Nanak, He Himself pervades all; the Guru-facing understand this. ॥8॥6॥7॥
The Guru's Bani is life-giving nectar, so sweet.
Rare is the Guru-facing one who has tasted and seen it.
ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ਮਹਾ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਵੈ; ਦਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦੁ ਵਜਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
Light dawns within, he drinks the supreme essence, and at the True Door the Word resounds for him. ॥1॥
ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ; ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who fix their consciousness on the Guru's feet.
ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਹੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਸਰੁ ਸਾਚਾ; ਮਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ. ਮੈਲੁ ਚੁਕਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
The True Guru is the true pool of nectar; bathing in it, the mind washes away its filth. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਤੇਰਾ ਸਚੇ; ਕਿਨੈ. ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
O True Lord, no one has found Your limits.
ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ; ਕਿਨੈ ਵਿਰਲੈ. ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
By the Guru's grace, rare is the one who has fixed his consciousness on You.
ਤੁਧੁ ਸਾਲਾਹਿ. ਨ ਰਜਾ ਕਬਹੂੰ; ਸਚੇ ਨਾਵੈ ਕੀ ਭੁਖ ਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
Praising You, may I never be satisfied; may hunger for the True Name stay with me. ॥2॥
I see only the One, and no other.
By the Guru's grace I have drunk the nectar.
ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਤਿਖਾ ਨਿਵਾਰੀ; ਸਹਜੇ ਸੂਖਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
Through the Guru's Word my thirst is quenched, and I merge in poise and peace. ॥3॥
One throws away the priceless jewel for a bit of straw.
The blind self-willed is attached to love of duality.
ਜੋ ਬੀਜੈ ਸੋਈ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਏ; ਸੁਪਨੈ. ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
Whatever he sows, that fruit he reaps; even in dreams he finds no peace. ॥4॥
ਅਪਨੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੇ; ਸੋਈ ਜਨੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
He alone obtains it on whom He shows His mercy,
and he enshrines the Guru's Word in his mind.
114: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਰਹੈ ਭੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ; ਭੈ ਮਾਰਿ. ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
Night and day he remains in the fear of God; through this fear he subdues the mind and dispels his wandering. ॥5॥
Dispelling doubt, he finds lasting peace.
By the Guru's grace he attains the supreme state.
ਅੰਤਰੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ. ਨਿਰਮਲ ਬਾਣੀ; ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਸਹਜੇ ਗਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
Within he is pure, and through the pure Bani he sings the Lord's praises with intuitive ease. ॥6॥
The pandit expounds the Simritees, Shastras and Vedas,
but deluded by doubt, he does not understand the essence.
ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ. ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਪਾਏ; ਦੁਖੋ ਦੁਖੁ ਕਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
Without serving the True Guru he finds no peace; he earns only pain upon pain. ॥7॥
He Himself acts; whom can anyone tell?
One would speak only if He were mistaken.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਆਪੇ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਏ; ਨਾਮੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੭॥੮॥
O Nanak, He Himself acts and causes all to act; through the Name one merges in the Name. ॥8॥7॥8॥
He Himself dyes them with intuitive ease;
ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ; ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਚੜਾਏ ॥
through the Guru's Word He dyes them in the Lord's love.
ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਰਤਾ, ਰਸਨਾ ਰੰਗਿ ਚਲੂਲੀ; ਭੈ ਭਾਇ. ਰੰਗੁ ਚੜਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
Mind and body are dyed, and the tongue is deep crimson with His love; through fear and love of Him, this colour is applied. ॥1॥
ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ; ਨਿਰਭਉ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who enshrine the Fearless Lord in their minds.
ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ. ਹਰਿ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਧਿਆਇਆ; ਬਿਖੁ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਤਰਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
By the Guru's grace they meditate on the Fearless Lord, and through the Word He carries them across the poisonous world-ocean. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
The foolish self-willed try to be clever,
but in spite of their bathing and washing, they are not accepted.
ਜੇਹਾ ਆਇਆ. ਤੇਹਾ ਜਾਸੀ; ਕਰਿ ਅਵਗਣ ਪਛੋਤਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
As they came, so they shall go; having done wrong, they repent. ॥2॥
They came with spiritual death written in their destiny, yet they do not understand.
ਮਨਮੁਖ ਕਰਮ ਕਰੇ. ਨਹੀ ਪਾਏ; ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ. ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
The self-willed perform rituals but do not attain; without the Name they waste their lives. ॥3॥
Practising Truth is the excellence of the Word.
Through the perfect Guru the door of liberation is found.
ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਣਾਏ; ਸਚਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਰੰਗਿ ਰੰਗਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
Night and day the Guru has them hear the Bani and the Word; imbued with the True One, they are dyed in His love. ॥4॥
ਰਸਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਿ ਰਾਤੀ; ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਏ ॥
The tongue is imbued with the Lord's essence, and delights in His love.
Mind and body are enticed with intuitive ease.
ਸਹਜੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਪਾਇਆ; ਸਹਜੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
Intuitively they have found their darling Beloved, and merge in poise upon poise. ॥5॥
ਜਿਸੁ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ; ਸੋਈ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
Only one with love within sings His praises.
ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ; ਸਹਜੇ ਸੁਖਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥
Through the Guru's Word he merges in poise and peace.
ਹਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਸਦਾ, ਤਿਨ ਵਿਟਹੁ; ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
I am forever a sacrifice to those who focus their consciousness on service to the Guru. ॥6॥
The True One is pleased only with Truth, with Truth alone.
By the Guru's grace one's inner being is drenched with love.
ਬੈਸਿ ਸੁਥਾਨਿ. ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ; ਆਪੇ ਕਰਿ ਸਤਿ ਮਨਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
Sitting in that blessed place (the heart), they sing the Lord's praises; He Himself instils faith in them. ॥7॥
ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ; ਸੋ ਪਾਏ ॥
One on whom He casts His glance of grace obtains it.
By the Guru's grace ego departs.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ; ਦਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੮॥੯॥
O Nanak, the Name dwells within the mind, and one is honoured at the True Door. ॥8॥8॥9॥
Serving the True Guru, one is blessed with great glory:
ਹਰਿ ਜੀ ਅਚਿੰਤੁ ਵਸੈ. ਮਨਿ ਆਈ ॥
the dear Lord, beyond all anxiety, comes to dwell in the mind.
ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ. ਸਫਲਿਓ ਬਿਰਖੁ ਹੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ; ਜਿਨਿ ਪੀਤਾ. ਤਿਸੁ ਤਿਖਾ ਲਹਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
The dear Lord is a fruitful tree, oozing nectar; whoever drinks it has his thirst quenched. ॥1॥
ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ; ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ; ਸਚੁ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to the True One who unites us in the true congregation.
ਹਰਿ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲੈ; ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
The Lord Himself unites us with the true congregation, and through the Guru's Word we sing the Lord's praises. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
115: I serve the True Guru, who has adorned me through the Word,
ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ; ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਇਆ ॥
who has enshrined the Lord's Name in my mind.
ਹਰਿ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ. ਹਉਮੈ ਮੈਲੁ ਗਵਾਏ; ਦਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
The Lord's Name is pure and washes away the filth of ego; one is honoured at the True Door. ॥2॥
ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ; ਨਾਮੁ. ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
Without the Guru the Name cannot be obtained.
Adepts and seekers have wept and wailed for it.
ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ. ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਹੋਵੀ; ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
Without serving the Guru there is no peace; by perfect destiny the Guru is found. ॥3॥
ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਆਰਸੀ; ਕੋਈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵੇਖੈ ॥
This mind is a mirror; rare is the Guru-facing one who sees himself in it.
ਮੋਰਚਾ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ; ਜਾ ਹਉਮੈ ਸੋਖੈ ॥
Rust does not stick to it when ego is dried up.
ਅਨਹਤ ਬਾਣੀ. ਨਿਰਮਲ ਸਬਦੁ ਵਜਾਏ; ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
The pure, unstruck Bani of the Word resounds within; through the Guru's Word one merges in the True One. ॥4॥
ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ; ਕਿਹੁ. ਨ ਦੇਖਿਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
Without the True Guru, nothing can be seen.
ਗੁਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰਿ; ਆਪੁ ਦਿਤਾ ਦਿਖਾਇ ॥
In His mercy the Guru has shown me my own self.
ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹਿਆ; ਸਹਜੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
He Himself, all by Himself, pervades all; one merges in poise upon poise. ॥5॥
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ; ਸੁ ਇਕਸੁ ਸਿਉ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਏ ॥
One who becomes Guru-facing is attuned to the One alone.
Doubt and duality are burnt away through the Guru's Word.
ਕਾਇਆ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਵਣਜੁ ਕਰੇ ਵਾਪਾਰਾ; ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
Within the body he trades and deals, and obtains the true treasure of the Name. ॥6॥
The way of life of the Guru-facing is to cherish the Lord's praise as most sublime.
The Guru-facing find the door of liberation.
ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤਾ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ; ਅੰਦਰਿ ਮਹਲਿ ਬੁਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
Night and day, dyed in His love, they sing His praises, and are called into the mansion of His presence. ॥7॥
The True Guru, the Giver, is met when the Lord unites us with him.
By perfect destiny the Word is enshrined in the mind.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ; ਹਰਿ ਸਚੇ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੯॥੧੦॥
O Nanak, the glory of the Name is obtained, singing the praises of the True Lord. ॥8॥9॥10॥
ਆਪੁ ਵੰਞਾਏ ਤਾ; ਸਭ ਕਿਛੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
When one sheds self-conceit, one obtains everything.
Through the Guru's Word one is lovingly attuned to the True One.
ਸਚੁ ਵਣੰਜਹਿ ਸਚੁ ਸੰਘਰਹਿ; ਸਚੁ ਵਾਪਾਰੁ ਕਰਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
They purchase Truth, gather Truth, and trade only in Truth. ॥1॥
ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ; ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ; ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਗਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who sing the Lord's praises night and day.
ਹਉ ਤੇਰਾ. ਤੂੰ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ; ਸਬਦਿ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਦੇਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
I am Yours, You are my Master; through the Word You bless with glory. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Beautiful are all those times and moments
when the True One is pleasing to my mind.
ਸਚੇ ਸੇਵਿਐ ਸਚੁ ਵਡਿਆਈ; ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ. ਸਚੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
Serving the True One, true glory is obtained; by the Guru's grace, the True One is found. ॥2॥
The food of love is obtained when the True Guru is pleased.
ਅਨ ਰਸੁ ਚੂਕੈ; ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
Other tastes are forgotten when one enshrines the Lord's essence in the mind.
ਸਚੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਸਹਜ ਸੁਖੁ ਬਾਣੀ; ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
Truth, contentment, poise and peace are obtained from the perfect Guru through his Bani. ॥3॥
ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ. ਨ ਸੇਵਹਿ; ਮੂਰਖ ਅੰਧ ਗਵਾਰਾ ॥
The foolish, blind and ignorant do not serve the True Guru;
ਫਿਰਿ ਓਇ ਕਿਥਹੁ; ਪਾਇਨਿ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰਾ ॥
how then shall they find the door of liberation?
ਮਰਿ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮਹਿ. ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵਹਿ; ਜਮ ਦਰਿ ਚੋਟਾ ਖਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
They die and die again to be reborn, again and again they come, and are beaten at Death's door. ॥4॥
ਸਬਦੈ ਸਾਦੁ ਜਾਣਹਿ; ਤਾ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣਹਿ ॥
When they know the taste of the Word, they recognise their own selves.
Through the pure Bani they speak the Word.
ਸਚੇ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਨਿ; ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਨਾਮੁ. ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
Serving the True One they find lasting peace, and enshrine in the mind the Name, the nine treasures. ॥5॥
ਸੋ ਥਾਨੁ ਸੁਹਾਇਆ; ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
Beautiful is that place (heart) which is pleasing to the Lord's mind,
where, sitting in the true congregation, one sings the Lord's praises.
ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਲਾਹਹਿ ਸਾਚਾ; ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਾਦੁ ਵਜਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
Night and day they praise the True Lord, and play the pure music of His praise. ॥6॥
116: The self-willed have false capital and a false display.
They practise falsehood and suffer terrible pain.
ਭਰਮੇ ਭੂਲੇ ਫਿਰਨਿ ਦਿਨ ਰਾਤੀ; ਮਰਿ ਜਨਮਹਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
Deluded by doubt, they wander day and night; they die, are reborn, and waste their lives. ॥7॥
My True Master is so very dear to me.
Through the perfect Guru's Word He is my support.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਾਮਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ; ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਮ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਨਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੧੦॥੧੧॥
O Nanak, through the Name glory is obtained; one looks upon pain and pleasure alike. ॥8॥10॥11॥
The sources of creation are Yours, and the forms of all beings are Yours.
Without the Name, all are deluded by doubt.
ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ. ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ. ਕੋਇ ਨ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
Through service to the Guru the Lord's Name is obtained; without the True Guru, no one obtains it. ॥1॥
ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ; ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who focus their consciousness on the Lord.
ਹਰਿ ਸਚਾ. ਗੁਰ ਭਗਤੀ ਪਾਈਐ; ਸਹਜੇ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
The True Lord is found through devotion to the Guru, and is enshrined in the mind with intuitive ease. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੇ; ਤਾ ਸਭ ਕਿਛੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
Serving the True Guru, one obtains everything.
ਜੇਹੀ ਮਨਸਾ ਕਰਿ ਲਾਗੈ; ਤੇਹਾ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
With whatever desire one comes to him, that fruit one receives.
ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਦਾਤਾ. ਸਭਨਾ ਵਥੂ ਕਾ; ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
The True Guru is the Giver of all things; by perfect destiny one meets him. ॥2॥
ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਮੈਲਾ; ਇਕੁ. ਨ ਧਿਆਏ ॥
This mind is filthy; it does not meditate on the One.
ਅੰਤਰਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਲਾਗੀ ਬਹੁ; ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਏ ॥
Within it is the great filth of love of duality.
ਤਟਿ ਤੀਰਥਿ ਦਿਸੰਤਰਿ ਭਵੈ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੀ; ਹੋਰੁ ਵਧੇਰੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਲੁ ਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
The egotist wanders to riverbanks, places of pilgrimage and foreign lands, and only gathers more filth of ego. ॥3॥
Serving the True Guru, the filth departs.
ਜੀਵਤੁ ਮਰੈ; ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਏ ॥
One remains dead (to ego) while alive, and fixes his consciousness on the Lord.
ਹਰਿ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਸਚੁ. ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ; ਸਚਿ ਲਾਗੈ. ਮੈਲੁ ਗਵਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
The Lord is pure and true; no filth sticks to Him; attached to the True One, one's filth is removed. ॥4॥
Without the Guru there is pitch darkness.
The ignorant are blind, in blinding darkness.
ਬਿਸਟਾ ਕੇ ਕੀੜੇ. ਬਿਸਟਾ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ; ਫਿਰਿ ਬਿਸਟਾ ਮਾਹਿ ਪਚਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
Worms in filth do filthy deeds, and in filth they rot again. ॥5॥
Serving the liberated one (the Guru), one is liberated.
Through the Word one sheds ego and possessiveness.
ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਸਚਾ ਸੇਵੀ; ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
Night and day serve the dear True Lord; by perfect destiny the Guru is found. ॥6॥
He Himself forgives and unites in union.
ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ; ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਏ ॥
From the perfect Guru one obtains the treasure of the Name.
ਸਚੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਦਾ ਮਨੁ ਸਚਾ; ਸਚੁ ਸੇਵੇ. ਦੁਖੁ ਗਵਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
Through the True Name the mind is forever true; serving the True One, pain is dispelled. ॥7॥
He is ever present; do not think Him far away.
Through the Guru's Word, recognise the Lord within.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਾਮਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ; ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੧੧॥੧੨॥
O Nanak, through the Name glory is obtained; it is received from the perfect Guru. ॥8॥11॥12॥
Those who are true here are true hereafter.
That mind is true which is absorbed in the True Word.
ਸਚਾ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ; ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
They serve the True One and practise Truth; they practise the Truth of truths. ॥1॥
ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ. ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ; ਸਚਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who enshrine the True Name in their minds.
ਸਚੇ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਵਹਿ; ਸਚੇ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
They serve the True One, merge in the True One, and sing the praises of the True One. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
The pandits read, but do not obtain the taste.
In love of duality they let the mind wander after Maya.
ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ. ਸਭ ਸੁਧਿ ਗਵਾਈ; ਕਰਿ ਅਵਗਣ ਪਛੋਤਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
Attachment to Maya has robbed them of all understanding; having done wrong, they repent. ॥2॥
When one meets the True Guru, one obtains the essence of reality,
and enshrines the Lord's Name in the mind.
117: ਸਬਦਿ ਮਰੈ. ਮਨੁ ਮਾਰੈ ਅਪੁਨਾ; ਮੁਕਤੀ ਕਾ ਦਰੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
One who dies through the Word and subdues his mind finds the door of liberation. ॥3॥
He cuts away his sins and gets rid of anger,
ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ; ਰਖੈ ਉਰ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
keeping the Guru's Word clasped to his heart.
ਸਚਿ ਰਤੇ ਸਦਾ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ; ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
Those imbued with the True One remain forever detached; subduing ego, they are united with Him. ॥4॥
Within is the jewel; it is found when the Guru leads one to it.
The mind's desire is threefold, for Maya is of three qualities.
ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਮੋਨੀ ਥਕੇ; ਚਉਥੇ ਪਦ ਕੀ ਸਾਰ. ਨ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
Pandits and silent sages have grown weary of reading, yet they do not find the essence of the fourth state. ॥5॥
He Himself dyes us; He Himself applies the colour.
ਸੇ ਜਨ ਰਾਤੇ; ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਰੰਗਾਏ ॥
Those humble beings are dyed whom He dyes through the Guru's Word.
ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਚੜਿਆ ਅਤਿ ਅਪਾਰਾ; ਹਰਿ ਰਸਿ ਰਸਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
The utterly infinite colour of the Lord's love is on them; steeped in the Lord's essence, they joyfully sing His praises. ॥6॥
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ; ਸਚੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਸੋਈ ॥
For the Guru-facing, the True One is wealth, spiritual power and self-discipline.
For the Guru-facing, there is spiritual wisdom, and liberation through the Name.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਾਰ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ; ਸਚੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
The Guru-facing practise the work of Truth, and merge in the Truest of the true. ॥7॥
The Guru-facing know that He creates, and having created, destroys.
For the Guru-facing, He Himself is caste and honour and everything.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਏ; ਨਾਮੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੧੨॥੧੩॥
O Nanak, the Guru-facing meditate on the Name, and through the Name they merge in the Name. ॥8॥12॥13॥
Creation and destruction happen through the Word (His command).
Through the Word, creation comes again.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਰਤੈ ਸਭੁ ਆਪੇ ਸਚਾ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਉਪਾਇ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
The Guru-facing know the True One Himself pervades all; having created, He merges in it. ॥1॥
ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ; ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who enshrine the perfect Guru in their minds.
ਗੁਰ ਤੇ. ਸਾਤਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ; ਗੁਣ ਕਹਿ. ਗੁਣੀ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
From the Guru comes peace; one worships day and night, and chanting His praises merges in the Virtuous One. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
The Guru-facing know that He is the earth, He is the water,
He is the air and the fire; He plays His wondrous play.
ਸੋ ਨਿਗੁਰਾ. ਜੋ ਮਰਿ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮੈ; ਨਿਗੁਰੇ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
One without a Guru dies and dies again to be reborn; the Guru-less keep coming and going. ॥2॥
The Creator has staged a play.
ਕਾਇਆ ਸਰੀਰੈ ਵਿਚਿ; ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
He has placed everything within the human body.
ਸਬਦਿ ਭੇਦਿ. ਕੋਈ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਾਏ; ਮਹਲੇ ਮਹਲਿ ਬੁਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
Rare is the one who, pierced by the Word, finds His mansion; He calls him into His presence. ॥3॥
True is the Banker, and true are His traders,
who trade in Truth, in infinite love for the Guru.
ਸਚੁ ਵਿਹਾਝਹਿ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ; ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
They purchase Truth and practise Truth; they practise the Truth of truths. ॥4॥
ਬਿਨੁ ਰਾਸੀ; ਕੋ ਵਥੁ ਕਿਉ ਪਾਏ ॥
Without capital, how can anyone buy the merchandise?
ਬਿਨੁ ਰਾਸੀ. ਸਭ ਖਾਲੀ ਚਲੇ; ਖਾਲੀ ਜਾਇ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
Without capital all depart empty-handed, and going empty-handed they suffer pain. ॥5॥
ਇਕਿ ਸਚੁ ਵਣੰਜਹਿ; ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
Some trade in Truth, through love for the Guru's Word.
They are saved themselves, and save all their families.
ਆਏ ਸੇ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਹੋਏ; ਮਿਲਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ. ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
Their coming into the world is approved; meeting the Beloved, they find peace. ॥6॥
The treasure is within, but the fool searches outside.
The blind self-willed wander about like demons.
ਜਿਥੈ ਵਥੁ ਹੋਵੈ. ਤਿਥਹੁ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ; ਮਨਮੁਖ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
Where the treasure is, there no one seeks it; the self-willed are lost in doubt. ॥7॥
He Himself gives it, and calls us through the Word.
In the mansion of His presence one finds the peace of poise.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਾਮਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ; ਆਪੇ ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਧਿਆਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੧੩॥੧੪॥
O Nanak, through the Name glory is obtained; He Himself hears and attends to all. ॥8॥13॥14॥
The True Guru has imparted this true teaching:
118: remember the Lord, who shall be your companion in the end.
ਹਰਿ ਅਗਮੁ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਅਨਾਥੁ ਅਜੋਨੀ; ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਇ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
The Lord is inaccessible, imperceptible, without master, unborn; He is found through love for the True Guru. ॥1॥
ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ; ਆਪੁ ਨਿਵਾਰਣਿਆ ॥
I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who rid themselves of self-conceit.
ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਏ. ਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਏ; ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Shedding self-conceit one finds the Lord, and merges with the Lord in poise. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
One acts out the good deed written by past actions,
and serving the True Guru, finds lasting peace.
ਬਿਨੁ ਭਾਗਾ. ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਨਾਹੀ; ਸਬਦੈ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
Without good fortune the Guru is not found; through the Word he unites us in union. ॥2॥
The Guru-facing remain detached in the world;
the Guru is their pillow, and the Name their support.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ. ਜੋਰੁ ਕਰੇ ਕਿਆ ਤਿਸ ਨੋ; ਆਪੇ ਖਪਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
What force can anyone use against the Guru-facing? Whoever tries is ruined and suffers pain. ॥3॥
The blind self-willed have no understanding at all.
They are murderers of their own souls and butchers of the world.
ਨਿੰਦਾ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਬਹੁ ਭਾਰੁ ਉਠਾਵੈ; ਬਿਨੁ ਮਜੂਰੀ. ਭਾਰੁ ਪਹੁਚਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
Slandering others, they carry a heavy load, carrying others' burdens without pay. ॥4॥
ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਵਾੜੀ; ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮਾਲੀ ॥
This world is a garden, and my God is the gardener.
He always takes care of it; no plant is left without His care.
ਜੇਹੀ ਵਾਸਨਾ ਪਾਏ ਤੇਹੀ ਵਰਤੈ; ਵਾਸੂ ਵਾਸੁ ਜਣਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
As the fragrance He places within, so it acts; by its fragrance the flower is known. ॥5॥
for it has forgotten the inaccessible, infinite Giver of peace.
ਦੁਖੀਏ ਨਿਤਿ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਬਿਲਲਾਦੇ; ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ. ਸਾਂਤਿ ਨ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
The miserable wander forever wailing; without the Guru they find no peace. ॥6॥
He who created them knows the way to heal them.
When He heals one, that one recognises His command.
ਜੇਹਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਪਾਏ. ਤੇਹਾ ਵਰਤੈ; ਆਪੇ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
As He places within, so one acts; He Himself turns us outward. ॥7॥
ਤਿਸੁ ਬਾਝਹੁ ਸਚੇ; ਮੈ. ਹੋਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
Besides that True One, there is no other for me.
ਜਿਸੁ ਲਾਇ ਲਏ; ਸੋ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
One whom He attaches to Himself becomes pure.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ; ਜਿਸੁ ਦੇਵੈ ਸੋ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੧੪॥੧੫॥
O Nanak, the Name dwells within the heart; one to whom He gives it receives it. ॥8॥14॥15॥
One who enshrines the life-giving Name in the mind
is rid of all the pain of ego and possessiveness.
ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਦਾ ਸਲਾਹੇ; ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
Through the life-giving Bani he praises the Lord forever, and through nectar obtains nectar. ॥1॥
ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ; ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਣੀ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who enshrine the life-giving Bani in their minds.
ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਣੀ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ; ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Enshrining the life-giving Bani in the mind, they meditate on the life-giving Name. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Such a one speaks nectar forever with his mouth.
With his eyes he sees and recognises the life-giving Lord everywhere.
ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਕਥਾ ਕਹੈ ਸਦਾ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ; ਅਵਰਾ ਆਖਿ ਸੁਨਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
Day and night he speaks the life-giving sermon, and tells it to others too. ॥2॥
Dyed in the love of the life-giving Lord, he is attuned to Him.
By the Guru's grace he obtains the nectar.
ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਰਸਨਾ ਬੋਲੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ; ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਆਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
Day and night his tongue speaks nectar; with mind and body he drinks the nectar. ॥3॥
ਸੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੈ; ਜੁ ਚਿਤਿ. ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
He does what no one can even imagine.
ਤਿਸ ਦਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ; ਮੇਟਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਕੋਈ ॥
No one can erase His command.
ਹੁਕਮੇ ਵਰਤੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਣੀ; ਹੁਕਮੇ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਆਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
By His command the life-giving Bani prevails; by His command He gives the nectar to drink. ॥4॥
Wonderful are the works of the Creator Lord.
He turns back this mind when it goes astray.
ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਏ; ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਸਬਦਿ ਵਜਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
He attaches it to the life-giving Bani, and through the life-giving Word His Name resounds within. ॥5॥
119: You Yourself created the counterfeit and the genuine.
ਖਰੇ ਪਰਖਿ ਖਜਾਨੈ ਪਾਇਹਿ; ਖੋਟੇ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
Testing the genuine, You place them in Your treasury; the counterfeit You let wander in doubt. ॥6॥
How can I see You? How can I praise You?
By the Guru's grace I praise You through the Word.
ਤੇਰੇ ਭਾਣੇ ਵਿਚਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਵਸੈ; ਤੂੰ ਭਾਣੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਆਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
Within Your will the nectar dwells; by Your will You give the nectar to drink. ॥7॥
The life-giving Word, the life-giving Bani of the Lord,
is enshrined in the heart by serving the True Guru.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ; ਪੀ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ. ਸਭ ਭੁਖ ਲਹਿ ਜਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੧੫॥੧੬॥
O Nanak, the life-giving Name is forever the Giver of peace; drinking this nectar, all hunger departs. ॥8॥15॥16॥
Nectar rains down, with intuitive ease.
Rare is the Guru-facing one who obtains it.
ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀ ਸਦਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਸੇ; ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਬੁਝਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
Drinking the nectar, they are satisfied forever; in His mercy He quenches their thirst. ॥1॥
ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਆਵਣਿਆ ॥
I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to the Guru-facing who drink the nectar.
ਰਸਨਾ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖਿ. ਸਦਾ ਰਹੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੀ; ਸਹਜੇ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Tasting the essence, the tongue stays forever dyed in His love, singing the Lord's praises with intuitive ease. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
By the Guru's grace, rare is the one who attains poise.
ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਮਾਰੇ; ਇਕਸੁ ਸਿਉ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਏ ॥
Killing duality, he is attuned to the One alone.
ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ. ਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ; ਨਦਰੀ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
When He casts His glance of grace, one sings the Lord's praises; by His grace one merges in the True One. ॥2॥
Your glance of grace, O God, is upon all,
on some a little, on others abundant.
ਤੁਝ ਤੇ ਬਾਹਰਿ. ਕਿਛੁ ਨ ਹੋਵੈ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
Nothing happens without You; the Guru-facing understand this. ॥3॥
The Guru-facing have reflected on the essence:
Your treasures are overflowing with nectar.
ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ. ਕੋਈ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ; ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
Without serving the True Guru no one obtains it; it is obtained by the Guru's grace. ॥4॥
One who serves the True Guru is beautiful.
Through the life-giving Name his inner mind is enraptured.
ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਬਾਣੀ ਰਤਾ; ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਣਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
His mind and body are dyed in the life-giving Bani; in poise he hears the life-giving melody. ॥5॥
The self-willed is lost, ruined by love of duality.
ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਲੇਵੈ; ਮਰੈ ਬਿਖੁ ਖਾਏ ॥
He does not chant the Name; eating poison, he dies.
ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਵਿਸਟਾ ਮਹਿ ਵਾਸਾ; ਬਿਨੁ ਸੇਵਾ. ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
Night and day he lives in filth; without service he wastes his life. ॥6॥
ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਵੈ; ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਪਿ ਪੀਆਏ ॥
He alone drinks the nectar whom the Lord Himself gives it to drink.
By the Guru's grace he is intuitively attuned to Him.
ਪੂਰਨ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ. ਸਭ ਆਪੇ; ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਦਰੀ ਆਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
The Perfect One Himself pervades all; through the Guru's teaching He is seen. ॥7॥
He Himself, by Himself, is the Pure Lord.
He who created it shall Himself destroy it.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ਸਦਾ ਤੂੰ; ਸਹਜੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੧੬॥੧੭॥
O Nanak, cherish the Name forever, and you shall merge intuitively into the True One. ॥8॥16॥17॥
ਸੇ ਸਚਿ ਲਾਗੇ; ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਏ ॥
Those who please You are attached to the True One.
They serve the True One forever, with intuitive ease.
ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਚਾ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ; ਸਚੈ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
Through the True Word may I praise the True One; they are united in union with the True One. ॥1॥
ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ; ਸਚੁ ਸਾਲਾਹਣਿਆ ॥
I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who praise the True One.
ਸਚੁ ਧਿਆਇਨਿ ਸੇ ਸਚਿ ਰਾਤੇ; ਸਚੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Those who meditate on the True One are dyed in the True One, and merge in the Truest of the true. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Wherever I look, the True One is in all places.
By the Guru's grace I enshrine Him in my mind.
ਤਨੁ ਸਚਾ ਰਸਨਾ ਸਚਿ ਰਾਤੀ; ਸਚੁ ਸੁਣਿ ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਨਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
The body becomes true and the tongue is dyed in Truth, hearing, speaking and describing the True One. ॥2॥
120: Subduing desire, one merges in the True One.
ਇਨਿ ਮਨਿ ਡੀਠੀ; ਸਭ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣੀ ॥
With this mind one has seen all the coming and going.
ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੇ. ਸਦਾ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ; ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
Serving the True Guru, the mind is forever steady, and dwells in its own true home. ॥3॥
Through the Guru's Word I have been shown the Lord within my heart.
Through the Word, attachment to Maya is burnt away.
ਸਚੋ ਸਚਾ ਵੇਖਿ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ; ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
Beholding the Truest of the true, I praise Him; through the Guru's Word, the True One is found. ॥4॥
ਜੋ ਸਚਿ ਰਾਤੇ; ਤਿਨ ਸਚੀ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
Those imbued with the True One are lovingly attuned to the True One.
Fortunate are those who cherish the Lord's Name.
ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ; ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਚੁ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
Through the True Word He Himself unites them; in the true congregation they sing the praises of the True One. ॥5॥
ਲੇਖਾ ਪੜੀਐ; ਜੇ ਲੇਖੇ ਵਿਚਿ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
One could read His account only if He were within any account.
ਓਹੁ ਅਗਮੁ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ; ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਧਿ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
He is inaccessible and imperceptible; through the Word, understanding comes.
ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਚ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ; ਹੋਰੁ; ਕੋਇ. .ਨ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
Night and day, through the True Word, I praise Him; no one else can know His worth. ॥6॥
ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਥਾਕੇ; ਸਾਂਤਿ ਨ ਆਈ ॥
People read and read and grow weary, yet find no peace.
Burnt by craving, they have no understanding at all.
ਬਿਖੁ ਬਿਹਾਝਹਿ. ਬਿਖੁ ਮੋਹ ਪਿਆਸੇ; ਕੂੜੁ ਬੋਲਿ ਬਿਖੁ ਖਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
They buy poison, thirst for the poison of attachment, tell lies and eat poison. ॥7॥
By the Guru's grace I know only the One.
Killing duality, the mind merges in the True One.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਏਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਰਤੈ ਮਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ; ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੧੭॥੧੮॥
O Nanak, the One Name pervades the mind; by the Guru's grace it is obtained. ॥8॥17॥18॥
In all colours and forms, it is You who pervade.
ਮਰਿ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮਹਿ; ਫੇਰ ਪਵਹਿ ਘਣੇਰੇ ॥
People die and die again to be reborn, going round many cycles.
ਤੂੰ ਏਕੋ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰਾ; ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਬੂਝ ਬੁਝਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
You alone are steady, inaccessible and infinite; through the Guru's teaching You give understanding. ॥1॥
ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ; ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who enshrine the Lord's Name in their minds.
ਤਿਸੁ ਰੂਪੁ ਨ ਰੇਖਿਆ. ਵਰਨੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ; ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਆਪਿ ਬੁਝਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
He has no form, no feature, no colour; through the Guru's teaching He Himself gives understanding. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਸਭ ਏਕਾ ਜੋਤਿ; ਜਾਣੈ ਜੇ ਕੋਈ ॥
The one Light pervades all, if only one knew it.
Serving the True Guru, it is revealed.
ਗੁਪਤੁ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਵਰਤੈ ਸਭ ਥਾਈ; ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
Hidden and manifest, He pervades all places; the light merges into the Light. ॥2॥
The world is burning in the fire of craving,
in greed, pride and great ego.
ਮਰਿ ਮਰਿ ਜਨਮੈ, ਪਤਿ ਗਵਾਏ ਅਪਣੀ; ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
Dying again and again to be reborn, one loses one's honour and wastes life in vain. ॥3॥
ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ; ਕੋ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਬੂਝੈ ॥
Rare is the one who understands the Guru's Word.
One who subdues self-conceit comes to know the three worlds.
ਫਿਰਿ ਓਹੁ ਮਰੈ. ਨ ਮਰਣਾ ਹੋਵੈ; ਸਹਜੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
Then he dies (to self) and does not die again; intuitively he merges in the True One. ॥4॥
ਮਾਇਆ ਮਹਿ ਫਿਰਿ; ਚਿਤੁ ਨ ਲਾਏ ॥
He does not fix his consciousness on Maya again;
ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ; ਸਦ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਏ ॥
through the Guru's Word he remains absorbed forever.
ਸਚੁ ਸਲਾਹੇ ਸਭ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ; ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਸੁਹਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
He praises the True One, who is in every heart; the Truest of the true makes him beautiful. ॥5॥
I praise the True One, who is ever present.
Through the Guru's Word He is seen pervading everywhere.
ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਸਚੁ ਨਦਰੀ ਆਵੈ; ਸਚੇ ਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
By the Guru's grace the True One is seen, and from the True One peace is obtained. ॥6॥
The True One remains merged deep within the mind.
ਸਦਾ ਸਚੁ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ; ਆਵੈ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
The True One is forever steady; He does not come or go.
ਸਚੇ ਲਾਗੈ. ਸੋ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ; ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
The mind attached to the True One is pure; through the Guru's teaching it merges in the True One. ॥7॥
I praise the True One, and no other,
serving whom there is lasting peace.
